summary.text: Lehman Franklin was elected to the Georgia House of Representatives in 2022 and represents House District 160.

paragraphs.text: He is a native of Statesboro, holds a B.S. in Business Administration from The Citadel (1997) and an MBA from Georgia Southern University (2002), and lives in Stilson.
He worked as a missionary in Argentina beginning in 2003 and later became dealer principal of Franklin Automotive Group, a family-run auto dealership business established in 1940.
